# --asserts--

`firstRepeated([3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 3])` debe devolver `1`, porque `1` se repite antes que `3`.

```javascript
tryCatch(firstRepeated([3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 3]) === 1);
```

`firstRepeated(["a", "b", "a"])` debe devolver `"a"`.

```javascript
tryCatch(firstRepeated(["a", "b", "a"]) === "a");
```

`firstRepeated([1, 2, 3])` debe devolver `undefined`.

```javascript
tryCatch(firstRepeated([1, 2, 3]) === undefined);
```

`firstRepeated([])` debe devolver `undefined`.

```javascript
tryCatch(firstRepeated([]) === undefined);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function firstRepeated(items) {
  let seen = new Set();
  for (const item of items) {
    if (seen.has(item)) {
      return item;
    }
    seen.add(item);
  }
  return undefined;
}
```
